title: Najena
respawn_note: eqlwiki revs 166006 and 166039, 4 Aug 2026, editor Grumpymixon, "Reset the spawn timer to actual value" then "More accurate respawn time", 19:00 to 4:45 to 4:50. Najena is NOT in the 28 Jul patch list, so this reads as correction of a long-wrong wiki figure. The page still contradicts itself: its Classic Era prose says 19 minutes while its infobox says 4:50.
placeholders_source: Official patch notes, 23 June 2026 revamp: “a striking lack of placeholders for named mobs”. The 28 July launch-day note does not name Najena — it names six other dungeons — and this site cited it here in error until 18 August 2026. The 23 June note is also no longer published: everquestlegends.com carries nothing older than 7 July, so a reader cannot check it. The corroborating wiki revision below names this zone too.

respawn_note: eqlwiki infobox, page last edited 4 Aug 2026; corroborated by eqlwiki Zone_Spawn_Timers. RESOLVED 18 Aug 2026, and it closed the way this note asked. It had said since 11 August that eqlwiki's rendering of the 28 July patch note named six dungeons without Blackburrow, while a fuller quotation supplied to us named eleven including it, and that one reading of the developers' own page would settle which. That reading has been done: the note names SIX — The Hole, Nagafen's Lair, Lower Guk, Lair of the Splitpaw, The Warrens and Castle Mistmoore — and Blackburrow is not among them. The eleven-zone quotation was wrong. So this zone was never in the launch-day pass and 22:00 is unaffected by it: not a pre-patch ceiling, just the wiki's figure. Stored verbatim at sources/raw/2026-07-28-eql-update-notes.txt.

title: Castle Mistmoore
verify_gate: All three gates cleared. Gates 1 and 2 on sourcing, checked 31 July 2026. Gate 3 was opened on 18 August when the revamp changed named spawns, named loot and aggro range, on the reasoning that nobody had checked whether the mesh moved with them. It did not. The client's mistmoore.s3d and mistmoore_obj.s3d are dated 11 May 2026, identical to every other zone archive in the install, and re-running _build/geometry.py against the live game regenerates assets/zone-geometry.json byte-for-byte - so the plotted coordinates are checked against the mesh the game is currently shipping. The revamp changed population and loot, not geometry. Re-measured in play the same day at Awakened and Adaptive.
